title: OtherMiscellaneousRecord
description: Flexible open schema for miscellaneous historical sources including fraternal/lodge records, society rosters, ephemera, receipts, and untyped manuscript items.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Contextual summary (e.g., '1925 Masonic Lodge Dues Receipt for William Lehman (Carlisle Lodge No. 260)').

source_urn.description: Adheres to URN:OTHER:[YEAR]:[JURISDICTION]:[LOCATOR] (using 9999 if year is undetermined).

name.description: Name of the lodge, fraternal order, church society, or commercial establishment (e.g., 'Carlisle Lodge No. 260 F&AM', 'Order of the Rainbow for Girls').

item_date.description: Document or artifact creation date (use modifier UNKNOWN and year 9999 if undetermined).

custom_fields.description: Dynamic open container allowing arbitrary domain key-value pairs created on the fly (e.g., lodge_degree, dues_amount, item_dimensions).

item_note.description: Physical description, artifact context, handwriting, or provenance notes.

transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of the item, abstract summary, and search keywords.

media_files.description: Scans or photos of the physical item or document.

associated_people.description: Array of participants linked to the item (members, officers, signatories, payees) mapped to roles and IDs.
